user.title: Tabula
user.description: Create an API key in Tabula under Settings → API settings, then paste it here.

data_description.api_key: Shown only once when created. Store it somewhere safe.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Tabula
reauth_confirm.description: The current API key is no longer valid. Enter a new key for the same company.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tabula
reconfigure.description: Replace the API key. It must belong to the same company.

config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Tabula company. In the UI, pick the company from the list. For YAML: open Settings → Devices & services → Tabula → the company entry; the id is the `config_entry=` value in the browser address bar.
